ALGER, 17/07/2026 (Algeria Tech) — Le mi: ALGIERS, 07/17/2026 (Algeria Tech) — Minister of Post and Telecommunications, Sid Ali Zourouki, chaired the graduation ceremony of the 2026 class of the National Higher School of Information and Communication Technologies and Posts (ENSTIC). A promotion of 120 new engineers trained in digital and telecommunications professions in Algeria.
Cérémonie de remise des diplômes de la p: Graduation ceremony for the ENSTIC class of 2026
Le ministre de la Poste et des Télécommu: The Minister of Post and Telecommunications, Mr. Sid Ali Zourouki, chaired, this Friday, July 17, 2026, the graduation ceremony of the 2026 class of the National Higher School of Information and Communication Technologies and Posts (ENSTIC). This event, organized in the premises of the establishment located in El Harrach (wilaya of Algiers), brought together the families of graduates as well as officials from the ministry and the ANPT (National Post and Telecommunications Agency).
La promotion 2026 de l'ENSTIC compte 120: The ENSTIC class of 2026 includes 120 new engineers specializing in the fields of telecommunications, information technology, cybersecurity, network management and postal services. These graduates will soon join the ranks of national and international operators, companies in the Algerian ICT sector, or join public administrations to contribute to the modernization of the country.
La formation de 120 nouveaux ingénieurs: The training of 120 new information technology and telecommunications engineers is part of national efforts to strengthen local skills in a booming sector. With a mobile penetration rate exceeding 120% in 2025 and more than 30 million internet subscribers, Algeria faces a growing demand for qualified human resources to support its digital transition. These graduates will directly contribute to reducing dependence on foreign skills and accelerating the country's technological sovereignty.
Le secteur des TIC algérien, porté par d: The Algerian ICT sector, driven by players like Algérie Télécom, Mobilis, Djezzy and Ooredoo, requires highly specialized profiles to meet the challenges of the digitalization of public services, cybersecurity and the deployment of 5G. The ENSTIC ceremony thus represents a key step in the national talent training strategy, aligned with the objectives of the 2030 Digital Plan.
Contexte du secteur TIC algérien: Context of the Algerian ICT sector
L'Algérie compte aujourd'hui plus de 58: Algeria today has more than 58 wilayas equipped with modern digital infrastructure, with a mobile penetration rate estimated at 125% in 2025, according to the latest data from ARPCE (Regulatory Authority for Post and Electronic Communications). The number of internet subscribers has exceeded 30 million, with an average annual growth of 8% over the past five years. The 2030 Digital Plan, launched in 2021, aims to position Algeria among the leading countries in technological innovation in Africa.
Algerie Télécom, opérateur historique, a: Algerie Télécom, historic operator, has invested more than 50 billion Algerian dinars (DA) since 2020 to modernize its fixed and mobile network, while private operators Mobilis, Djezzy and Ooredoo have deployed thousands of kilometers of optical fibers to improve 4G coverage and prepare for the arrival of 5G. The ARPCE plays a central role in regulating the sector, ensuring fair competition and universal access to digital services.
Le ministre de la Poste et des Télécommu: The Minister of Post and Telecommunications, Sid Ali Zourouki, stressed during his speech that “the training of Algerian engineers is an essential pillar to achieve the country's ambitions in terms of digital sovereignty and international competitiveness”. He also recalled that “ENSTIC remains a strategic establishment to meet the needs of the ICT labor market, with programs constantly adapted to technological developments”.
Le directeur de l'ENSTIC, Pr. Mohamed La: The director of ENSTIC, Prof. Mohamed Lamine Benkhelifa, for his part indicated that “this 2026 class marks an important stage in the history of the school, with graduates ready to take on the challenges of Algeria’s digital transformation”. He added that “partnerships with local and international companies allow students to benefit from training in line with market realities”.
Les nouveaux diplômés de l'ENSTIC seront: New graduates from ENSTIC will be integrated into the job market from September 2026, with priority given to the country's strategic projects, particularly in the wilayas least covered in digital infrastructure. The Ministry of Post and Telecommunications plans to organize additional training sessions for newly graduated engineers, in collaboration with telecom operators and local startups.
Par ailleurs, l'ENSTIC annonce l'ouvertu: Furthermore, ENSTIC announces the upcoming opening of a new sector dedicated to artificial intelligence and data science, in response to the growing demand from Algerian and African companies. This specialization will be added to existing training in cybersecurity, cloud computing and network management, thus strengthening the school's role as a driving force for technological innovation in Algeria.
